warnings: House title block: '(024)?' not printed directly — series name printed on cover/title block is 'บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 8 (ต้านทานแผ่นดินไหว)', เลขที่แบบ AR 60007 / S60164, กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง กระทรวงมหาดไทย, ปี 2560. Small 2-storey house, single-bay-and-a-half structure (3x5 column grid, only 2 column lines on the short axis: 1,2,3), full hip roof framed in cold-formed light-gauge steel (จันทันเหล็ก C-100x50x20x3.2mm@1.00m; ตะเข้สัน/อกไก่ 2x C-100x50x5x7.5mm and 2x C-100x50x20x3.2mm variants — see roof plan file for the steel-shape-symbol ambiguity noted there) over an RC frame (footings, columns, floor beams, ring beam, stair, precast-plank floors).

Dummy grid '1'' at x=-1.10m: primarily justified by an actual BEAM endpoint — S-04/S-05 (floor1 and floor2 plans, หน้า31/32) both print a beam segment marked 'B3X' running from grid D1/C1 west to the building edge, on the same printed 1.10m offset as the x dimension chain's 'edge-1' segment. Also used by the floor-2 tie-column mark 'CN2' at the same offset (D row), supporting the cantilevered 2nd-floor balcony edge. Floor 1's equivalent tie-column ('CN1') sits directly ON grid D1/C1 with no west extension there (only the B3X beam extends west at floor 1). Named '1'' (negative pos_m before the origin) per the house-04/house-05 precedent in the spec (§4).

Dummy grid '3'' at x=7.00m (0.50m east of grid 3): sourced from the printed edge-offset dimension on S-04/S-05/S-06 (หน้า31/32/33), where a short beam stub marked 'BX' and a small slab pocket marked 'S2' project east past grid 3 by the printed 0.50m. This is a genuine beam endpoint (BX), so per the beam-endpoint rule a dummy grid was added. Same BX stub appears at all three levels (floor1 beam plan, floor2 beam plan, ring-beam plan) at the same position.

The west overhang (1.10m before grid 1) and the south carport slab (marked 'S0', south of grid A, referenced 'ดูขยาย 2' -> S-18/หน้า45) print NO beam outline around them (thin single-line boundary only, no double-line beam symbol) — per the spec's explicit 'do NOT invent a dummy for a slab-only edge' exception, no dummy grid was added for those; they are recorded as unassigned_dimensions instead. Likewise the roof eave overhangs (1.00m on all 4 sides, from S-07/หน้า34) carry only spacing-based repeated rafters (no discrete beam endpoint), so no dummy grid was added for them either — recorded as unassigned_dimensions.

Dummy grids '1"' at x=+1.75m and 'C'' at y=5.95m: added 2026-08-26 from S-06/หน้า33 (ring-beam plan), both flagged by Makham. 1" carries an RB2 running the full row C to row B (4.00m) with two CX roof pedestals sitting on it; C' carries a short RB1 running from 1" east to grid2 (1.75m) with a third CX at its east end. UNLIKE the other dummies in this file these two ARE dimensioned on the sheet: the printed '1.75' runs from grid2 back to the RB2, and the printed '0.75' runs from row C down to the RB1 — and both measure CENTRE-TO-CENTRE, not to a face (pixel scan: RB2 faces 1.65/1.85 about a 1.75 centreline; RB1 faces 5.85/6.05 about a 5.95 centreline). So no face-vs-centreline question arises for these two.

RENAMING done 2026-08-26 when 1" (+1.75) was added: the line previously called 1" (+2.25, S-04's B6) became 2', and the line previously called 2' (+4.70, the S2 bay's west edge) became 2". Reason: the '1' family only has two prime slots (' and ") and three dummies now sit between grid1 and grid2. +2.25 is nearer grid2 (1.25m) than grid1 (2.25m) so it moves into the '2' family, and within that family the primes still read west-to-east: 2' = 2.25 then 2" = 4.70. Reading the whole axis left to right the names now run 1', 1, 1", 2', 2, 2", 3, 3'. Every grid_ref on S-04/หน้า31 and S-05/หน้า32 was rewritten to match, and each renamed element carries a flag saying so.

Dummy grids '2'' at x=+2.25m and '2"' at x=+4.70m: added 2026-08-26 after Makham flagged a beam missing from the row D-C strip on S-04/หน้า31. Both are genuine beam endpoints — 2' carries the 'B6' beam on the east side of the stair opening, 2" carries a 'B1' beam that forms the west edge of the dropped 'S2' bay — and both appear at the same x on S-04 and S-05 (หน้า31/32). NEITHER is dimensioned anywhere in the structural set, so pos_m is a PIXEL MEASUREMENT off the PNG, not a printed value: scale 78.70 px/m calibrated on grid1-grid2 (3.50m) and the row chain E-A (10.70m); 2' centreline scans at 2.249m (faces 2.15/2.35, west face exactly on the stair opening edge), 2" at 4.700m (faces 4.60/4.80). Recorded under Makham's standing ruling that an undimensioned but real beam line gets a dummy grid rather than 'unresolved'; every element using them carries a measured-not-printed flag. NAMING follows the house-13 reading-order scheme: primes are handed out west-to-east along the axis, so the line before grid1 is 1', and within each family the primes read west-to-east; where a family runs out of slots the line joins the family of the named grid it is nearest to (see the renaming warning).

Dummy grid 'B'' at y=10.10m (0.90m south of row B): added 2026-08-26 after Makham flagged S-05/หน้า32's 'B4X' as far too long at 1.50m. The east 'S1' room on floor 2 is only 0.90m deep, not 1.50m — B4X runs down grid3 from row B and dies on this room's south edge beam, which then runs west to grid2. That edge beam is the endpoint, so per the beam-endpoint rule it gets a dummy row; it also explains why no footing exists at 'A3' on either foundation plan. Undimensioned, so pos_m is a PIXEL MEASUREMENT: the beam's two faces scan 0.70 and 0.90 south of row B (0.203m apart), i.e. outer face at 10.10, centreline at 10.00. Recorded at 10.10 (outer face) to stay consistent with 1' and 3' in this same file — if Makham rules for centrelines, all three move together: 1' -1.00, 3' 6.90, B' 10.00, and B4X becomes 0.80. Appears on S-05/หน้า32 only; floor 1 has the open carport here instead.

PRINTED-FACE vs CENTRELINE — RULED by Makham 2026-08-26: keep the printed values, do NOT shift to centrelines. '1'' stays at -1.10, '3'' at 7.00 and 'B'' at 10.10, so B3X = 1.10, BX = 0.50 and B4X = 0.90. All three of those numbers land on the OUTER FACE of a 0.20m-wide edge beam rather than on its centreline (pixel scan: west edge beam centreline -1.00, east 6.90, row-B' edge beam 10.00), which is the situation house 31's ruling sends to the centreline — but here, unlike house 31, 1.10 and 0.50 are printed segments of the sheet's own main x dimension chain (edge-1-2-3-edge) and B' matches them by convention, so the printed value stands. The interior dummies 2' (2.25) and 2" (4.70) are centrelines regardless, since nothing is printed for them, and 1" (1.75) / C' (5.95) are centrelines because the sheet dimensions them centre-to-centre.

z_levels is nearly empty: none of the Pass-2 (structural) sheets in this house print an absolute floor-height table (no '+0.60 ระดับพื้นชั้น1' style callout on any plan/section sheet extracted). The single z-level found anywhere in scope is '+6.65ม.' on S-13/หน้า40 ('เสา CN2 ขึ้นจากขั้น 2 – ถึง+6.65ม.', i.e. the pedestal CN2 rises from floor-2 level up to the ring-beam/eave level at +6.65m). Full floor-height data would require the architectural elevation/section sheets (A-07 to A-13, pattern side_profile), which are Pass-3 and out of op04 scope for this house — documented here rather than guessed.
